audit_refactor_findings.change: Introduced cleanup_sync_staged_transfer_artifacts as a first-class terminal-state-checked cleanup boundary instead of silently deleting sidecars inside materialization.
audit_refactor_findings.finding: Rev0672 receipt-gated materialization left committed .part.chunks sidecars in the staging root, creating ambiguous ownership between resume evidence and completed transfer evidence.

audit_refactor_findings.change: Cleanup verifies the materialized target matches the remote content evidence and refuses to run while the staged .part file still exists.
audit_refactor_findings.finding: Cleanup must not destroy evidence for an in-progress transfer or a forged terminal state.

audit_refactor_findings.change: Cleanup removes only receipt files whose material matches the exact remote entry, apply key, and chunk tuple, and rejects unexpected receipt-directory artifacts.
audit_refactor_findings.finding: Receipt directories may contain unexpected material if a caller or crash recovery path points cleanup at the wrong entry.
